cues.en: As we've seen, it's very difficult to evaluate collaborative filtering without running expensive experiments on real world users.
cues.zh: 如前所見，不對真實使用者執行昂貴實驗，就很難評估協同過濾。

cues.en: Since they aren't based on making rating predictions, we can't really measure their accuracy offline.
cues.zh: 因為它們不做評分預測，所以無法真正離線衡量準確程度。

cues.en: So, the concept of collaborative filtering has been applied to recommender systems that do make rating predictions, and these are generally referred to in the literature as KNN recommenders.
cues.zh: 因此，人們把協同過濾概念，套用到會預測評分的推薦系統，文獻中通常稱為 KNN 推薦系統。

cues.en: Let's have a look at how they work.
cues.zh: 看看如何運作。

cues.en: Let's revisit the architecture of a recommender system based on rating predictions.
cues.zh: 回顧以評分預測為基礎的推薦系統架構。

cues.en: In this sort of system, we generate recommendation candidates by predicting the ratings of everything a user hasn't already rated, and selecting the top K items with the highest predicted ratings.
cues.zh: 這類系統會預測使用者尚未評分的所有項目，再選出預測評分最高的前 k 個，作為推薦候選。

cues.en: From there, everything else works more or less the same way.
cues.zh: 之後，其餘部分的運作大致相同。

cues.en: This obviously isn't a terribly efficient approach, but since we're predicting rating values, we can measure the offline accuracy of the system using train/test or cross-validation, which is useful in the research world.
cues.zh: 這顯然不是很有效率，但因為預測評分值，就能使用訓練／測試或交叉驗證，衡量系統的離線準確程度，這在研究領域很有用。

cues.en: Our challenge then, is to somehow predict ratings using our data on item or user similarities, so we can still call this collaborative filtering.
cues.zh: 挑戰是，如何利用項目或使用者相似度資料預測評分，讓它仍然能稱為協同過濾。

cues.en: One way is to base those predictions on the top K items or users with the best similarity scores, which is why we call this approach K nearest neighbors.
cues.zh: 一種方式，是根據相似度最高的前 k 個項目或使用者預測，因此稱為 k 最近鄰。

cues.en: Let's dive into how that works.
cues.zh: 深入看看。

cues.en: So for the user-based KNN approach, here's how it works.
cues.zh: 使用者式 KNN 的運作方式如下。

cues.en: Since we're trying to predict ratings for a given user and item, we start by finding similar users to the user in question.
cues.zh: 因為要預測某位使用者對某個項目的評分，先找出與目標使用者相似的人。

cues.en: But we need to restrict this to users who have also rated the item in question.
cues.zh: 但必須限制為，也評分過目標項目的使用者。

cues.en: We restrict this to some number K of similar users.
cues.zh: 再將數量限制為 k 位相似使用者。

cues.en: So we end up with a set of ratings from K similar users for this item.
cues.zh: 因此，得到 k 位相似使用者對這個項目的評分集合。

cues.en: These are our K nearest neighbors, together with a measure of how similar the user is to the user we're making a prediction for.
cues.zh: 這些就是 k 個最近鄰，並且知道各使用者與目標使用者有多相似。

cues.en: Next we do a weighted average of the user similarity scores for each associated rating, weighted by the ratings themselves.
cues.zh: 接著，對各筆評分相關的使用者相似度做加權平均，以評分本身加權。

cues.en: This gives us a reasonable prediction of how this user might rate this item, based on similar users who also rated this item.
cues.zh: 根據也評分過這個項目的相似使用者，就能合理預測目標使用者可能給的評分。

cues.en: You can see it's similar in spirit to the user-based collaborative filtering approach we described earlier, but it's completely different in how it works.
cues.zh: 你可以看到，精神上與前面描述的使用者式協同過濾類似，但運作方式完全不同。

cues.en: It still uses a user-to-user similarity matrix at its core, but we're not just recommending stuff that people similar to you liked.
cues.zh: 核心仍是使用者間相似度矩陣，但不只是推薦與你相似的人喜歡的東西。

cues.en: Instead, we're reaching deeper into the data to try and make predictions about ratings for every possible item for every possible user.
cues.zh: 而是更深入資料，試圖預測每位可能使用者，對每個可能項目的評分。

cues.en: It's a more complex approach, and usually that's a bad thing.
cues.zh: 這是更複雜的方法，通常複雜不是好事。

cues.en: Here's the fancy math for what we just said, using the same notation as the SurpriseLib documentation.
cues.zh: 這是剛才說法的數學公式，使用與 SurpriseLib 文件相同的符號。

cues.en: It says that the predicted rating for user u and item i is equal to the sum of the k nearest users, where we call each of these k-nearest users v.
cues.zh: 它表示，使用者 u 對項目 i 的預測評分，來自最近 k 位使用者的加總，將每位最近鄰稱為 v。

cues.en: We sum up the products of the similarity scores between users u and v as we go, multiplied by the rating given to this item by user v.
cues.zh: 加總使用者 u 與 v 的相似度，乘以使用者 v 對這個項目的評分。

cues.en: Then we divide by just the sum of those user similarity scores, to end up with a weighted average that can be used as a rating prediction.
cues.zh: 再除以這些使用者相似度的總和，得到可用於評分預測的加權平均。

cues.en: Item-based KNN works exactly the same, we just flip the words user and item.
cues.zh: 項目式 KNN 完全相同，只要把使用者與項目兩個詞對調。

cues.en: So to predict the rating of a user u for an item i, we start with the set of k items also rated by this user that are most similar to item i.
cues.zh: 因此，要預測使用者 u 對項目 i 的評分，先從這位使用者也評分過的項目中，找出與 i 最相似的 k 個。

cues.en: From there, it's the same deal.
cues.zh: 接著做法相同。

cues.en: Compute the weighted average of the sims cores by rating, and you have yourself a reasonable rating prediction to work with.
cues.zh: 按評分對相似度做加權平均，就能得到合理的評分預測。

cues.en: The math is identical, except we're looking at similarities between items i and j instead of users u and v here.
cues.zh: 數學公式一樣，只是這裡看項目 i 與 j 的相似度，而不是使用者 u 與 v。

cues.en: So again, the predicted rating is based on the set of the K most-similar items also rated by this user to the item in question.
cues.zh: 因此，再次說明，預測評分根據的是：這位使用者也評分過、與目標項目最相似的 k 個項目。

cues.en: We sum up all the item similarity scores weighted by their ratings, and divide by the sum of the similarity scores.
cues.zh: 將所有項目相似度，按評分加權後加總，再除以相似度總和。

cues.en: It's kind of shoe-horning the concept of collaborative filtering into a framework built around rating predictions, but it's not that bad of a rating predictor as we'll see.
cues.zh: 這有點像把協同過濾硬塞進以評分預測為核心的框架，但我們會看到，它的評分預測其實不差。

cues.en: If your goal however is create top-N recommendations, you're probably better off with the simpler, more direct approach we described earlier.
cues.zh: 不過，如果目標是產生 Top-N 推薦，使用前面較簡單、直接的方法，可能更好。

cues.en: Fortunately, KNN is an algorithm that's built into SurpriseLib, so we can experiment with it without having to write much code at all.
cues.zh: 幸好，KNN 是 SurpriseLib 內建演算法，所以幾乎不用寫什麼程式碼，就能實驗。

cues.en: Let's take a look.
cues.zh: 來看看。
